title: Senior Marketing Manager
description:
Senior Marketing Manager - Remote (US/EU)
Must have: Marketing Automation, Social Media, Content Marketing, Market Research, SEO
Experience: At least 6 years of relevant experience
Good to have: Paid Search, A/B Testing, Copywriting
Tasks: Create and edit content for web, email and social media; Manage budgets and agencies; Work with sales and product on launches; Plan and run multi-channel campaigns
